statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, then for every j with 0 ≤ j < len(nums) it holds that j < len(r) and r[j] equals the sum of nums[k] for k = 0, 1, ..., j.
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(nums) ≤ 1000, and for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(nums), -10^6 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10^6.

statement: For every input satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result r; it does not fail (no integer overflow, no out-of-bounds access, no panic).
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(nums) ≤ 1000, and for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(nums), -10^6 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10^6.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, len(r) = len(nums).
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(nums) ≤ 1000, and for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(nums), -10^6 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10^6.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every pair of indices i, j with 0 ≤ i ≤ j < len(nums) and j < len(r), r[j] - r[i] = the sum of nums[k] for k = i+1, ..., j (this sum is 0 when i = j).
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(nums) ≤ 1000, and for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(nums), -10^6 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10^6.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with len(r) = len(nums) = n, the sum of r[j] over j = 0, ..., n-1 equals the sum of (n - i) · nums[i] over i = 0, ..., n-1.
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(nums) ≤ 1000, and for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(nums), -10^6 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10^6.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with len(r) = len(nums), if nums[i] ≥ 0 for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(nums), then r[j] ≤ r[j+1] for every j with 0 ≤ j < len(r) - 1.
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(nums) ≤ 1000, and for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(nums), -10^6 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10^6.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with len(r) = len(nums), if nums[i] ≤ 0 for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(nums), then r[j] ≥ r[j+1] for every j with 0 ≤ j < len(r) - 1.
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(nums) ≤ 1000, and for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(nums), -10^6 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10^6.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with len(r) = len(nums), letting mn = min over 0 ≤ i < len(nums) of nums[i] and mx = max over 0 ≤ i < len(nums) of nums[i], for every j with 0 ≤ j < len(nums), (j + 1) · mn ≤ r[j] ≤ (j + 1) · mx.
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(nums) ≤ 1000, and for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(nums), -10^6 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10^6.
